chunks: They will offer excuses to you when you return to them. Tell them: 'Make no excuses; we do not believe you. God has informed us about your affairs; and God and His Apostle shall see your deeds. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the Hidden and the Manifest, and He will inform you of what you used to do.'

key_terms.عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ: The Knower of the Hidden and the Manifest

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of God informing the believers about the hypocrites' secrets in Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from the Prophet's era to the era of the Imams, where the 'All-Knowing of the Unseen and the Seen' is often interpreted as the Imam who possesses divine knowledge of the hearts. It underscores the concept of *Taqiyya* and the ultimate accountability of the hypocrites, whose outward professions of faith mask inner disbelief, a theme central to the struggle between the Ahl al-Bayt and their opponents.
